editor-and-import.reason: Editor, import, upload, restore and read/base helpers require exact admitted intent and evidence; existing materialization and best-effort transcript publication do not establish parity.
required_evidence: Migrate actual HTTP and non-HTTP callers to the shared governed implementation.
Preserve conflict/resolution and exact observed bases; attribute external writes only as observed.

agent-turn.reason: Agent turn boundaries, automatic merge and autosync mutate or observe shared workspace state and need their causal command/effect/result mapping.
required_evidence: Retain actor, delegation, input taint and exact turn/candidate bases.
Reconcile interrupted merges and commits without manufacturing success or losing external uncertainty.

authoring.reason: Definition reads, ability edits, archetype construction and version freezing combine durable authoring work with temporary workspace views.
required_evidence: Separate admitted authored bytes and immutable versions from derived materialization.
Bind every durable authoring change and release result to its originating authenticated command.

startup-and-migration.reason: Startup migration, reconciliation and recovery can import or change durable work without an HTTP request; bootstrap must not manufacture a work grant or retroactive actor.
required_evidence: Declare the migration/observation boundary and preserve legacy or unknown provenance.
Map durable effects and recovery to their actual authority; classify disposable initialization separately.

topology-and-settlement.reason: Workspace construction, homing, promotion and target settlement require shared command/effect/result provenance under their existing independent authorities.
required_evidence: Preserve reservations, CAS, exact candidate/target bases and compensation identity.
Qualify partial application, current authority and interrupted recovery without a second settlement machine.

native-action-boundary.reason: These are native input/target custody and action-boundary calls already exercised by the editor foundation; entry-point migration and other callers remain open.
required_evidence: Retain current actor/policy and ownership fencing plus input/base/result exclusion.
Connect the qualified runtime evidence and product admission to live entry points without an alternate writer.

native-workspace-adapter.reason: Native workspace methods adapt the owning WhippleScript stores, including read-triggered imports, versioned changes, topology and disposable materialization.
required_evidence: Map each effectful adapter call to an admitted operation; storage-engine writes do not recursively become commands.
Preserve exact native cuts and retention, and identify observation-only or derived paths explicitly.

external-workspace-adapter.reason: External-folder and Git adapters retain external authority and may perform file or process effects; native history cannot stand in for their observation ceiling.
required_evidence: Bind exact external bases and declared apply/publish/reconciliation capability.
Keep opaque process footprints and unknown external authorship explicit; do not retry uncertain effects blindly.

custody-and-erasure.reason: Credential, content-key and quarantine cleanup sites share workspace method names but belong to dedicated custody/erasure authorities.
required_evidence: Verify the actual receiver and admitted custody/erasure outcome rather than inferring a workspace call from its name.
Retain permitted metadata only; secret bytes never enter generic commands or runtime evidence.

publication-review.reason: Publication-shaped sites can emit projections or invoke another authority; syntax alone cannot establish whether a durable or external effect occurs.
required_evidence: Resolve the actual receiver and distinguish admitted-fact notification from directory, package or other external publication.
A projection notification is derived only when it creates no independent durable work or effect.

route-reference.reason: These qualified function references register handlers with capability-shaped names; the referenced handler and its downstream effects require explicit mapping.
required_evidence: Link each registration to its actual authenticated command factory and result path.
A handler reference is not itself proof of runtime mediation or an exemption for the handler body.

native-recording-boundary.reason: Native recording descriptors bind the actual selected store and namespace, with a separate read-only historical evidence adapter. Home admission retains exact input and a fenced independent command/outbox; delivery verifies original admission and current authority. Execution resolves the retained input under the Home fences and invokes the runtime-owned recording door after exact target, scope and IFC checks. Independent inspection authenticates the current reader, preserves all original and current metadata restrictions and validates the original Home input mapping before reading the actual historical batch through a read-only adapter. Reconciliation uses its independently admitted outbox and retained read policy, current investigator authority and an explicitly acquired actual-Home runtime epoch. The owner verifies the original execution, input mapping and actual historical target batch before publishing a disposition; the Home admits only the pinned runtime acknowledgment, with no recording retry or workflow advance. Product result admission independently checks the committed reconciliation/outbox/acknowledgment, undisputed Applied history and actual original batch, then records the owner's exact ordered outcomes under the current product fence. Reads return only the immutable admitted metadata under current access and all retained result restrictions, without opening runtime, target or input databases or promising body availability. Derived-input handling and activation remain open.
required_evidence: Derive input and scope from current Home authority and invoke only the runtime-owned fixed recording profile after durable dispatch.
Preserve original attribution and first-wins outcomes without advancing file heads or reconstructing erased bodies.
Authorize an independent investigator before reading the original target receipt; do not treat an absent receipt as non-application.
Refuse stale or foreign-Home ownership, missing outboxes and revoked current investigators; recover a lost acknowledgment from the exact runtime receipt without retrying the target.
Keep original batch attribution and both merge orientations, including inserted=false for existing winners; a later investigator or result-admitting reader never becomes their original author.
Refuse missing admission, acknowledgment, target receipt or product commit receipt, and disputed runtime evidence; retain stricter historical metadata restrictions after target policy relaxation.

Recover product commit failures under the same result identity without runtime or target mutation; independently authorize read-only historical result retrieval after backing runtime or target removal.
